treatments.rationale: Derives nonnegative variation potential and contact by admissible mass addition, compact fractional removal and continuity; support contact does not assert contact at arbitrary off-support points.
Derives interior contact slopes and treats the one-sided origin condition separately from an interior minimum.

Develops the zero-expectation divergence correction with sign, quotient-extension, tail and boundary controls; positivity is established after integration, not for the uncorrected polynomial pointwise.
Displays the rational identity and complete positive remainder table; algebraic verification is one ingredient alongside the separate analytic signs and vanishing flux.
States the common fixed-time inequality, proves its continuity-point transfer, and explains the distinct coefficient-derivative terms in its plateau and minimizing applications.
Applies the fixed-time estimate on a positive plateau and proves a strictly positive Hessian moment for the limiting solution.
Uses the heat equation and a positive-time density, avoiding division by the vanishing coefficient.

Reconstructs the terminal Brownian correlation and value identity from the bounded martingale and attained Parisi formula; its first curvature moment differs from the second moment used in gap exclusion.

Assembles the requested-accuracy construction from the stated classical, synthesis, seed-removal and fixed-word transfer inputs, fixing one ordinary word before system size tends to infinity; no quantitative depth or complete formal replay is asserted.

Derives the smooth-density part through a continuous quotient and simultaneous polynomial-moment bootstrap. Strict positivity is the separate density-positive passage; full support alone does not establish either conclusion.
Applies the shared fixed-time spatial estimate after smoothness and moment saturation. Its proof destination records the nonminimizing artificial plateaus and fixed-strip transfer.

reading_links.rationale: Expands the mass-variation and endpoint-contact part of the exposition; the target also uses a separate curvature input.
Expands the short account into the finite-step sign comparisons, zero-expectation correction, exact certificate and integrated inequality; the continuity-point transfer is developed separately.
Supplies the finite-step analytic and algebraic steps behind the integrated bound; the approximation argument is developed in the separate fixed-time-coercivity passage.
Expands the smoothness and no-origin-atom part of the short density account; strict positivity is developed in a separate long passage.

Expands the fixed-time transfer used in the short density proof: positive finite-step approximations preserve the coefficient at the selected continuity point, and compact-strip control passes the spatial moments to the limit. Smoothness and the final minimizing application are separate steps.
Develops the strict-positivity argument cited by the further-reading note; it is additional to the no-gap theorem.
Develops the terminal value identity described in the short paper; finite Gaussian approximation remains a separate part of the construction.
Expands the final error allocation and order of choices after the separate synthesis and seed-removal inputs; it does not replace those inputs by the scalar statement.

Develops the continuity-point transfer of the integrated inequality, proves strict curvature on positive plateaus for the limiting solution, and treats the zero plateau separately without dividing by the coefficient.
